value_policy: Names and static source metadata only. Never read process environment values.

entries.name: WEBLEDGER_INSURANCE_REVIEW_MANIFEST
entries.required: optional; matching page disabled when absent
entries.evidence: Read-only owner matching input; launcher opts in using insurance_review.manifest_path. No PDF content is served.

entries.name: WEBLEDGER_DATA_ROOT
entries.required: required for run_candidate; absent is refused
entries.evidence: Static environment read and callsite captured by the verifier; no runtime value is inspected.

entries.name: WEBLEDGER_DATA_DB
entries.required: fallback only when WEBLEDGER_DB is absent
entries.default: none; missing both database settings is refused
entries.evidence: Static pick call uses this as the fallback environment name for db_path.

entries.name: WEBLEDGER_DATA_EXPORTS
entries.required: fallback only when WEBLEDGER_EXPORT_DIR is absent
entries.default: none; missing both export settings is refused
entries.evidence: Static pick call uses this as the fallback environment name for export_dir.

entries.name: WEBLEDGER_EVIDENCE_DIR
entries.required: required for durable configuration unless fallback alias is set
entries.default: none; missing both evidence settings is refused
entries.evidence: Static pick call resolves evidence_dir from this name then WEBLEDGER_DATA_EVIDENCE.

entries.name: WEBLEDGER_DATA_EVIDENCE
entries.required: fallback only when WEBLEDGER_EVIDENCE_DIR is absent

entries.name: WEBLEDGER_DATA_SOURCE
entries.required: fallback only when WEBLEDGER_SOURCE_DIR is absent

entries.name: WEBLEDGER_RECEIPTS_STORE

entries.evidence: Static environment read and callsite captured by the verifier; no runtime value is inspected.

entries.name: WEBLEDGER_TRIP_AUTHORITY
entries.evidence: When present, load trip authority JSON; absent means period verification returns false without it.

entries.name: WEBLEDGER_EVIDENCE_ROOT
entries.evidence: Optional root that source locators must remain under; source fallback is D:/WebLedgerHost/data/evidence.

entries.name: WEBLEDGER_OTA_MAIL_DIR
entries.evidence: Optional override; otherwise data-directory/ota-mail.

entries.name: WEBLEDGER_OTA_SOURCES
entries.evidence: Optional manifest path; absent uses data-directory/ota-sources.json. Explicit missing manifest is an error.

entries.name: WEBLEDGER_OTA_SOURCES_JSON
entries.evidence: Optional JSON object; absent falls back to manifest and derived data-directory sources.

entries.name: WEBLEDGER_OTA_REVIEW_DB
entries.evidence: Optional; review UI remains disabled unless an absolute path and isolated mode are both present.

entries.name: WEBLEDGER_OTA_REVIEW_MODE
entries.evidence: Optional; only exact value isolated enables isolated review mode.

entries.name: WEBLEDGER_OTA_AUTHORITY
entries.evidence: Optional; exact authority selects authority mode; otherwise enabled review remains isolated.

entries.name: WEBLEDGER_REVIEW_CONFIG
entries.evidence: Optional config path; unset leaves real-review config unconfigured.

entries.name: WEBLEDGER_REVIEW_REFRESH_STATUS
entries.evidence: Optional path for refresh status input/output.

entries.name: WEBLEDGER_REVIEW_FROM
entries.default: 2026-04-01 in history_policy; empty in card flow
entries.evidence: Optional date string; history policy defaults to 2026-04-01 while card-flow callsites default empty.

entries.name: WEBLEDGER_UNIFIED_DB
entries.evidence: Optional; exact value 1 opts into unified database behavior.

entries.name: WEBLEDGER_RULE_LEASE_TTL
entries.evidence: Optional numeric float; module default is 300 seconds.

entries.name: WEBLEDGER_FLIGHT_PASSENGER_MATCHING
entries.evidence: Optional; exact value 1 enables the passenger review routes.

entries.name: WEBLEDGER_FLIGHT_PASSENGER_DB
entries.evidence: Optional; only an absolute configured path is accepted; otherwise path is unavailable.

entries.name: RESERVATION_INTERNAL_BASE_URL
entries.evidence: Optional override; defaults to the source constant https://reserve.foresttour.kr; HTTPS required except loopback HTTP.

entries.name: RESERVATION_INTERNAL_API_TOKEN
entries.required: optional if token file is configured
entries.evidence: Optional credential value; read only for authorization and never included in public status.

entries.name: RESERVATION_INTERNAL_API_TOKEN_FILE
entries.required: optional if token value is configured
entries.evidence: Optional token-file path; first nonempty line is used; a per-board private token file is also a caller fallback.

entries.name: OPENROUTER_API_KEY
entries.evidence: Optional credential-presence check; photo transmission additionally requires explicit approval; auth-file fallback is separate.

entries.name: WEBLEDGER_RECEIPT_INKLING
entries.evidence: Optional; exact value approved is required before OpenRouter-backed photo processing.

entries.name: WEBLEDGER_RECEIPT_VISION
entries.evidence: Optional; Windows-only and exact provider selector opencode-muse-free.

entries.name: WEBLEDGER_OPENCODE_EXE
entries.evidence: Optional executable path; when unset searches PATH then the platform npm-global location.

entries.name: APPDATA
entries.evidence: Optional Windows-provided location used only to locate npm global opencode.cmd.

entries.name: WEBLEDGER_OTA_MATCHING_DEFAULTS
entries.evidence: Optional path used only if the bundled defaults file is absent; schema mismatch raises an error.

entries.name: WEBLEDGER_AGODA_PORTAL_DB
entries.evidence: Optional override; otherwise checks data-directory/agoda-portal.sqlite then retained source-tree staging path.

entries.name: WEBLEDGER_GUIDE_AIRPORTS
entries.evidence: Optional override passed to airport table loader; absent selects its built-in table.

entries.name: WEBLEDGER_LOCAL_RULE_AI
entries.evidence: Optional; exact value 1 enables loopback-only interpretation.

entries.name: WEBLEDGER_RECEIPT_OCR
entries.default: disabled unless Windows and provider selected
entries.evidence: Optional; enabled only on Windows and exact value windows.

entries.name: WEBLEDGER_RECEIPT_LEARNING
entries.default: none; feature/source remains unavailable when unset
entries.evidence: Optional JSONL path; absent disables saved lessons.

entries.name: WEBLEDGER_EXPORT_DIR
entries.default: webledger-exports (durable production config refuses relative defaults)
entries.evidence: Optional override; direct board fallback is webledger-exports; durable production config prefers WEBLEDGER_DATA_EXPORTS and requires absolute path.

entries.name: WEBLEDGER_RESERVE_SOURCE
entries.default: none; feature/source remains unavailable when unset
entries.evidence: Optional path to reserve source snapshot/config; unset leaves the optional source unconfigured.

entries.name: WEBLEDGER_OTA_EXACT_GATE
entries.evidence: app.ota_exact.enabled reads ENV with default 1; only exact 0 disables.

entries.name: WEBLEDGER_PARTICIPANT_DB
entries.evidence: default_db_path returns the configured Path or this static local archive path.

entries.name: WEBLEDGER_CLASSIFICATION_WRITER
entries.required: optional; only the value rust selects the Rust core
entries.evidence: selected() compares the stripped lowercase value with rust; unsetting is the rollback.

entries.name: WEBLEDGER_LINKS_PRODUCER
entries.required: optional; only the value rust selects the Rust core for refund pairs
entries.evidence: selected() compares the stripped lowercase value with rust; unsetting is the rollback. Independent of WEBLEDGER_CLASSIFICATION_WRITER.

entries.name: WEBLEDGER_COSTCORE_BIN
entries.required: required only when the writer or the links producer is rust
entries.default: none; rust writer refuses without it
entries.evidence: apply() refuses with CORE_WRITER_NOT_CONFIGURED when absent.

entries.name: WEBLEDGER_CORE_DB
entries.required: required when the writer is rust or stored periods are read
entries.evidence: Path of core.sqlite (decisions, decision_history); read-only for stored_service_period.
